checks_before_registration: Three feature/loader tests pass. On the actual full86394-row June3BTC sample, both delays have finite features, identical common top-one fields and exact first10000-row prefix parity. Tests cover future-outcome exclusion, deeper-quantity invariance of top-one controls, multiplicative price/quantity unit invariance, unavailable states, strict timestamp boundaries and frozen row/label/clock preservation. Ruff passes.
features: Top-one has27 own fields: availability, publisher age, venue basis/spread/depth contrasts, imbalance and microprice, plus strictly historical1s/5s/15s returns, basis/imbalance/spread changes, sampled endpoint queue-transition pressure and history-availability flags. Top25 adds61fields: five selected rank queue/price profiles, cumulative5/10/25-level imbalance and liquidity shape/concentration/weighted prices, sampled endpoint multi-level transition pressure and exponentially distance-weighted liquidity kernels.
joins: Keep original220 observed-context fields and original labels/times exactly. Add27own+6peer fields for top-one(253columns), or88own+10peer for top25(318columns). Peer rows must match exactly the same original eligible decision timestamp.
normalization: Prices use observed spreads or basis points, quantities displayed-depth ratios, and signed/log1p transforms. No fitted normalization or outcome appears in feature construction. All invalid or incomplete foreign states are zero with explicit availability.
source_description: Bybit top-one and top25 states are extracted from the same native orderbook500 stream at matched added publisher delays. The top-one control is not a separate native BBO feed.
transition_math: At each level, compare sampled endpoint states using I(bid_now>=bid_old)qbid_now-I(bid_now<=bid_old)qbid_old-I(ask_now<=ask_old)qask_now+I(ask_now>=ask_old)qask_old. These are endpoint transition measurements, not the integral of all intervening flows, identified cancellations or fills.
